full_judgment:
10. Mr. lamiruddin Sircar, the learned Advocate appearing for the accused petitioners submits that the extension of the period of limitation granted by the learned Sessions Judge expired on 24.11.86 (or at best on 25.11.86) that the petitioners, therefore, rightly submitted application for their release and for stopping the investigation which was erroneously rejected by the Upazila Migistrate by his order dated 4.12.86, that in Criminal Motion No. 97 of 1986 the learned Sessions judge, Pabna set aside the said order dated 4.12.86 passed by the Upazila Magistrate, Iswardi and the learned Sessions judge ordered on 23.5.87 (as corrected on 23.6.87) as follows :- 

 14. Since the order of stopping the investigation and releasing the accused persons was actually passed by the Upazilla Magistrate on 23.6.87 in accordance with the direction of the learned Sessions Judge, it cannot be said that the limitation of the period of six months is to be counted form 4.12.86 and not from 23.6.87. On the ground already stated by us the limitation of period of six months for revival of investigation by the District Magistrate is to be counted from the actual date of the Magistrate's order stopping the investigation and releasing of the accused persons from custody on 23.6.87. Therefore we find no illegality in the impugned order dated 19.7.87 passed by the District Magistrate reviving the investigation of the case.
